title: alcea striata
intro: Alcea striata, commonly known as Striped Hollyhock or Prairie Hollyhock, is a perennial plant species native to North America. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful in the treatment of various conditions such as arthritis and skin issues. The therapeutic actions of Alcea striata include its ability to soothe and calm the body, reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
